transcript.text: Thanks for calling Rapid Response Plumbing, you're through to Elsie. How can I help?
Oh thank God, yes, hello! My kitchen pipe's just burst and there's water absolutely everywhere - can you get someone out here urgently, it's an absolute nightmare!

Oh no, don't panic — you've called the right place! Let me get someone out to you as soon as possible.

Can I grab your name first?
Yeah, it's Dave Wilkinson - please hurry, the water's still pouring out and I've got towels everywhere trying to catch it!

Right, Dave, first thing — if you haven't already, try turning off your stopcock to stop the flow! It's usually under the sink or near the water meter.

Can you give me your address so I can get a plumber heading your way?
Oh right, yeah, good thinking — I'll do that now! The address is 14 Oak Lane, Manchester, M14 5TP — how long do you think someone can get here?

Got it, 14 Oak Lane, Manchester, M14 5TP. I can't give you an exact time but a plumber will call you straight back to confirm — they'll get to you as fast as they can!

Can we reach you on the number you're calling from?
Yeah, that's fine - it's 07853 992555. Cheers Elsie, I really appreciate it, speak to you soon!

Perfect, so that's Dave Wilkinson, burst pipe, 14 Oak Lane Manchester M14 5TP — someone will call you back on 07853 992555 right away. Hang tight, Dave, help's on the way! I've just texted you a confirmation too. Take care, Dave — bye for now!

input.message: Hi Dave, it's Elsie from Rapid Response Plumbing. We've got your details and a plumber will be calling you back shortly for your emergency at 14 Oak Lane, Manchester, M14 5TP. In the meantime, make sure your stopcock is turned off if you can. 🚨

verdict.notes: Excellent handling — Elsie reassured the caller immediately, captured all key details, offered practical stopcock advice, gave a clear callback commitment, confirmed everything in a clean summary, and sent an SMS confirmation. No issues identified.
